note: The ground pool: every fill tile, motif ground and edge of the kit, seeded from docs/art/PRE_RICH_REDRAW.md in its rank order (the rank is the row there) at 64 px per tile. Status is derived from files by tools/src/art/status.ts, never written here. Pool fields beside the kit:gen ones: kit_id (the sprite it becomes), rank, blocked_by (an open owner call or the DECISIONS title that holds it), new (a kit id the kit gains on pick), retired (the DECISIONS title that retired it). docs/art/PRODUCTION_LINE.md sections 1 and 6.
